scenario.description: While walking in the park, an unexpected mishap leaves one unable to continue due to a twisted ankle.

agent_a.name: Liam

profile.personality_and_values: Liam Johnson is reserved, empathetic, and slightly anxious. His priority is security, guided by logical decision-making.
profile.public_info: Liam Johnson is a dedicated dog owner and can often be seen walking his aging Border Collie around the neighborhood.

agent_a.goal: Help your friend get to a medical facility (<extra_info>Extra information: Your friend needs immediate medical attention but cannot walk due to the pain.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Liam wants to help his friend get to a medical facility because he prioritizes security and logical decision-making in emergencies.

agent_b.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Johnson, a creative yet somewhat reserved individual, values power and fairness. He likes to analyse situations before deciding.
profile.public_info: Ethan Johnson is famous for cooking Italian food.

agent_b.goal: If your friend offers you help, accept their help and rationalize the cost of the ambulance (<extra_info>Extra information: You are worried about the cost of the ambulance, but you believe it's the safest way to get to a hospital.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ethan is motivated to accept help and rationalize the ambulance cost because he values fairness and believes it's the safest option.
